schemes.oauth2.description: "Zendesk OAuth 2.0 access tokens. When an operation lists multiple
scopes, a token needs only one of the scopes to authorize the request.
This behavior differs from the OpenAPI specification, in which all
scopes listed for a security scheme are required.
"
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["account_settings:read"]: "View account settings. Includes account configuration, ticket and user fields, and workspaces."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["account_settings:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete account settings. Includes account configuration, ticket and user fields, and workspaces."

schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["any_channel:write"]: "Push messages from an external channel into Zendesk. Includes creating tickets, comments, and users from an integrated channel. Write only."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["apps:read"]: "View installed apps and their settings. Includes a list of installed apps and each app's settings."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["apps:write"]: "Install, configure, and remove apps. Includes installing and uninstalling apps, changing settings, and uploading custom app packages."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["auditlogs:read"]: "View audit logs, which provide an account-wide record of who changed what and when."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["brands:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete brands and their agent assignments."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["custom_objects:read"]: "View custom objects. Includes custom object definitions and record attachments."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["custom_objects:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete custom objects. Includes definitions and record attachments."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["deletion_schedules:read"]: "View deletion schedules. Includes data retention policies that automatically delete tickets, users, and other data."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["deletion_schedules:write"]: "Delete deletion schedules. Includes deleting data retention policies."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["dynamic_content:read"]: "View dynamic content items and language variants."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["dynamic_content:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete dynamic content items and language variants."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["groups:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete groups and their memberships."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["hc:read"]: "View Help Center content. Includes articles, sections, categories, community posts and comments."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["hc:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete Help Center content. Includes articles, sections, categories, community posts and comments."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["macros:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete macros and their attachments."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["organizations:read"]: "View organizations and their details. Includes memberships, subscriptions, and merge history."

schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["organizations:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete organizations and manage their memberships. Includes adding and removing users, managing subscriptions, and merging organizations."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["requests:write"]: "Submit and edit support requests. Includes creating new requests and adding comments to existing ones."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["satisfaction_ratings:write"]: "Submit satisfaction ratings. Includes rating a ticket as good or bad with an optional reason."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["security:read"]: "View security and sign-in settings. Includes password policies, session timeouts, IP restrictions, and SSO configuration. Read only."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["sla_policies:write"]: "Create, edit, delete, and reorder SLA and group SLA policies."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["themes:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete Guide themes. Includes importing, updating, publishing, exporting, and deleting themes."

schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["ticket_attachments:write"]: "Upload, edit, and delete ticket attachments. Includes uploading files, updating and deleting attachments, and redacting them."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["ticket_views:read"]: "View ticket views and the tickets they return."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["tickets:read"]: "View tickets. Includes ticket contents, comments and conversation history, tags, forms and fields, audits, events, and metrics."

schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["tickets:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete tickets. Includes adding comments, tags, merging tickets, marking spam, attachments, forms, and custom statuses."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["triggers:read"]: "View triggers, trigger categories, and their revision history."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["triggers:write"]: "Create, edit, delete, and reorder triggers and trigger categories."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["users:read"]: "View users. Includes identities, active sessions, group, organization, and brand memberships, roles, and settings."

schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["users:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete users and manage their access. Includes resetting passwords, ending sessions, adding identities, changing memberships, and managing custom roles."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["web_widget:write"]: "Edit Web Widget settings and configuration. Write only."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["zis:read"]: "View private integrations. Includes configurations, connections, and inbound webhooks."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.["zis:write"]: "Create, edit, and delete private integrations. Includes configurations, connections, and inbound webhooks."

schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.impersonate: "Allows Zendesk Support admins to make requests on behalf of end users. See [Making API requests on behalf of end users](/documentation/ticketing/using-the-zendesk-api/making-api-requests-on-behalf-of-end-users/)."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.read: "Read all data. Gives access to GET endpoints, including permission to sideload related resources."
schemes.oauth2.flows.authorizationCode.scopes.write: "Write all data. Gives access to POST, PUT, and DELETE endpoints."
schemes.sessionAuth.description: "Authenticated browser session. POST requests also require CSRF protection."
